completeness_matrix.capability: Run history: find, distinguish, and reopen historical runs
completeness_matrix.evidence: ResearchPage.tsx RecentRuns fetches getResearchHistory({limit: 10}) only -- ticker/status/date badges shown, correctly routes completed/partial runs to /research and everything else to /processing (so an incomplete run is never mistaken for 'no structure'). The backend API itself supports cursor pagination and ticker/status filtering (frontend/src/api/client.ts getResearchHistory signature), but the UI never exposes cursor, ticker filter, status filter, or a 'load more'/'view all' control.
completeness_matrix.tests: App.test.tsx and ResearchPage.test.tsx reference getResearchHistory/RecentRuns; a dedicated 'load more'/pagination interaction test was not found.

This is a real, usable workflow for recent activity, but not a complete run-history feature.

final_determination.MVP_CORE_FUNCTIONS_COMPLETE_reason: Areas A-D (Research page, Evidence detail, Structure Graph, Conflict Radar+invalidation) are each fully usable, verified against actual component source. Area E (Run history + Result export) is only PARTIAL on both halves: run history has no discovery path beyond the 10 most recent runs, and result export has no user-facing workflow producing a complete run summary -- only a narrow unclassified-findings download exists.
final_determination.MVP_DEMO_CRITICAL_FLOW_COMPLETE_reason: The demo-critical flow (Research -> Structure Graph -> Evidence -> Conflict Radar, including the do-not-force/insufficiency demonstration) does not require run-history search beyond a known run or a result-export feature.
